**Calculation:**

⇒ In the above table it is given that different states produce different amounts of Rice, Wheat, Jowar, Pulses and other food grains

⇒ Total wheat production by all the states = 113 + 96 + 42 + 47 + 32 + 25 + 18 + 38 = 411

⇒ Total wheat production by state P only = 113

⇒ Percentage of wheat produced by state P = (113)/(411) × 100% = 27.50%

**Therefore, the percentage of wheat produced by state P alone is 27.50 percent.**
